_comment: Editor UI strings. Keys are stable internal identifiers and never change with the language. English is the fallback for every other language; anything omitted here falls back to the built-in default compiled into the call site.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_EDITOR_DESC: The language the Modularity editor itself is displayed in. This is a global editor preference and is not written into the project.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_EDITOR_LANGUAGE_DESC: Applies immediately to open windows. Stored per user, never in project files.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_EDITOR_RELOAD_DESC: Re-reads Resources/Languages from disk. Useful while writing a translation.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_EDITOR_MISSING_DESC: Keys requested this session that no language defined. They render as the key itself.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_MODUCPP_DESC: The localized ModuCPP syntax this project's scripts are written in. Independent of the editor language.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_MODUCPP_LANGUAGE_DESC: Keywords only. Classes, fields, methods, namespaces and assets are never renamed.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_MODUCPP_USE_GLOBAL_DEFA: Follow the global ModuCPP code language instead of storing a per-project choice.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_MODUCPP_GLOBAL_DEFAULT_: The ModuCPP code language new projects start with, and the fallback for projects that do not override it.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_MODUCPP_TRANSLATE_DESC: Rewrites every .moducpp file under Assets/ into the selected syntax language.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_MODUCPP_DICTIONARY_DESC: The dictionary this language compiles through. It is the only part of the compiler that changes between languages.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_MODUCPP_DICTIONARY_NONE: English is the canonical ModuCPP syntax, so it has no aliases.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_IMPORT_DESC: What to do when a script written in another supported language is imported.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_IMPORT_ON_IMPORT_DESC: Detected automatically from the imported source. 'Ask every time' shows the import popup.
LANGUAGE_MANAGER_IMPORT_ASK_AGAIN_DESC: Re-enables the import popup that was dismissed with 'Don't ask again'.
DIALOG_TRANSLATE_PROJECT_BODY: Rewrite every .moducpp script in this project into %s?
DIALOG_TRANSLATE_PROJECT_NOTE1: Only language keywords and built-in API aliases change.
DIALOG_TRANSLATE_PROJECT_NOTE2: Classes, fields, methods, namespaces and assets keep their names.
DIALOG_TRANSLATE_PROJECT_NOTE3: Behavior and generated C++ stay identical.
DIALOG_TRANSLATE_IMPORT_QUESTION: Translate them to this project's ModuCPP syntax language (%s)?
DIALOG_TRANSLATE_IMPORT_NOTE1: They compile and behave identically either way.
DIALOG_TRANSLATE_IMPORT_NOTE2: Only language keywords change; class, field, method and asset names do not.
DIALOG_OS_LANGUAGE_BODY: Your system language is %s. Modularity is currently in %s.
DIALOG_OS_LANGUAGE_NOTE: You can change this any time in Project Settings > Language Manager.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_PHYSICS_BACKEND_DESC: Engine used for 3D simulation. Jolt is the cross-platform default (works on Android). PhysX is available on desktop only. Switching rebuilds the active physics world.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_GLOBAL_GRAVITY_DESC: 3D and 2D runtime gravity use this project-wide multiplier.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_PHYSICS_TIMESTEP_DESC: Fixed simulation step used by project physics.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_SOLVER_ITERATIONS_DESC: More iterations improve stability at a CPU cost.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_PHYSICS_MODES_DESC: Enable the physics systems this project expects to use.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_DEFAULT_DISTANCE_DESC: Fallback max distance for raycast-style project defaults.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_HIT_TRIGGERS_DESC: Whether default raycasts should include trigger-style colliders.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_DEFAULT_MASS_DESC: New Rigidbody mass before per-object edits.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_DEFAULT_DRAG_DESC: New Rigidbody linear drag before per-object edits.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_MASS_UNITS_DESC: Changes how Rigidbody mass values are shown and converted.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_BOUNCINESS_DESC: Default restitution for new physics materials.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_RENDERER_API_DESC: Changing this may require an editor restart.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_AMBIENT_COLOR_DESC: Base light color used by the OpenGL renderer.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_SHADOW_RESOLUTION_DESC: Higher values can look sharper but cost more GPU memory.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_AUTO_RELOAD_SHADERS_DE: Reloads shaders while editing. Useful for shader development.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_VSYNC_DESC: Synchronize presentation to the display refresh.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_TARGET_FPS_DESC: Runtime frame-rate target when VSync is not controlling presentation.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_RENDER_SCALE_DESC: Scales the runtime render resolution globally. Below 1 renders fewer pixels and stretches up; above 1 supersamples.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_HDR_DESC: Renders to float color buffers so bright values survive for bloom and tone mapping. Turning it off forces 8-bit color.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_COLOR_RESOLUTION_DESC: Storage precision of the offscreen color buffers. Auto keeps 16-bit float; 8-bit halves bandwidth for strictly LDR projects.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_TEXTURE_FILTERING_DESC: Default sampling mode for newly authored materials.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_GLOBAL_TEXTURE_FORMAT_: GPU storage format every texture defaults to. Auto adapts per texture; per-texture overrides in the File Browser still win.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_ANTI_ALIASING_DESC: Default anti-aliasing level for player rendering.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_EDITOR_PREVIEW_OVERRID: Allow editor previews to use editor-specific graphics settings.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_GAME_PREVIEW_OVERRIDES: Allow the Game View to override runtime graphics defaults.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_RENDERING_PATH_DESC: How many realtime lights a scene may use. Directional lights keep guaranteed slots on top of the budget.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_MAIN_LIGHT_DESC: Per Pixel keeps directional lighting on; Off removes directional lights from shading.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_CAST_SHADOWS_DESC: Whether directional lights may render shadow maps.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_ADDITIONAL_LIGHTS_DESC: Per Pixel keeps point/spot/area lights on; Off drops them from shading.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_PER_FRAME_LIMIT_DESC: Hard cap on lights uploaded to the shader each frame (nearest lights win). The rendering path budget still applies on top.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_CAST_SHADOWS_2_DESC: Whether point/spot/area lights may render shadow maps.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_MAX_DISTANCE_DESC: Directional shadows only cover this far from the camera. 0 follows the camera far plane; smaller values sharpen shadows.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_SOFT_SHADOWS_DESC: Allows the softened shadow mode. Off forces hard shadows even on lights configured as soft.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_LIGHTING_RESOLUTION_DE: Internal render scale for the 2D light buffers. Auto adapts to output resolution and light count; turn it off to render at exactly this scale. Ships with the game.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_LIGHTING_FILTER_DESC: How the 2D lighting output is filtered. Off is bilinear (smooth); on is nearest, giving crisp pixel-art light and skipping the bilinear taps when sampling the light buffers (a little cheaper per pixel). Ships with the game.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_LIGHTING_DEPTH_DESC: Internal format of the 2D lighting buffers. Off is HDR RGBA16F; on is SDR RGBA8, which halves the lighting-buffer bandwidth (runs faster) but clamps overbright/additive light at white. Ships with the game.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_LIGHT_STATS_OVERLAY_DE: Show the 2D lighting statistics overlay in the viewport.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_ACTIVE_2_D_LIGHTS_DESC: Enabled 2D lights that contributed on the last frame.
SETTINGS_CONSOLE_CONSOLE_MODE_DESC: Choose how the console should appear by default.
SETTINGS_CONSOLE_ALWAYS_OPEN_ON_LAUNCH_D: Show the console automatically when the editor opens this project.
SETTINGS_CONSOLE_OPEN_ONLY_ON_ERRORS_DES: Keep the console quiet until errors happen.
SETTINGS_CONSOLE_CONSOLE_TONE_DESC: Choose expressive or professional console message wording.
SETTINGS_AUDIO_FEEDBACK_SOUNDS_DESC: Plays short editor sounds for clicks and status feedback.
SETTINGS_AUDIO_PREVIEW_VOLUME_DESC: Volume for audio previews in editor tools.
SETTINGS_AUDIO_SOUND_CATEGORIES_DESC: Developer toggles for individual editor sound groups.
SETTINGS_PLAYER_DEFAULT_SCENE_DESC: Scene loaded first by the player.
SETTINGS_PLAYER_FULLSCREEN_STARTUP_DESC: Launch the player fullscreen by default.
SETTINGS_PLAYER_NATIVE_DISPLAY_RESOLUTIO: Render at the device's actual display surface size instead of the Startup Resolution above. On Android this is the EGL surface size (e.g. tablet's native res); on desktop, the GLFW window framebuffer. Recommended for mobile builds so 16:9 content doesn't get stretched into a 16:10 panel.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_PROJECT_MODE_DESC: Choose the default editing pipeline for this project.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_PIXEL_GRID_SNAP_DESC: Keeps 2D object movement aligned to whole pixels.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_SNAP_STEP_DESC: Pixel size used by the 2D grid snap.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_PREVIEW_RESOLUTION_DESC: Controls the internal preview render size. Lower values improve performance or create a retro look.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_CUSTOM_PREVIEW_SIZE_DESC: Used only when Preview Resolution is Custom.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_AUTO_FIT_PREVIEW_DESC: Automatically fits the game preview inside its panel.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_PREVIEW_ZOOM_DESC: Manual zoom used when Auto Fit Preview is off.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_CANVAS_GUIDES_DESC: Shows reference guides for UI layout while editing.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_UI_CANVAS_PREVIEW_DESC: Shows UI canvas previews in editor viewports while not playing.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_UI_WORLD_GRID_DESC: Shows the grid while editing world-space UI.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_TOOLBAR_CORNER_DESC: Moves the scene viewport toolbar to a different corner.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_VIEWPORT_HINTS_DESC: Shows short helper hints in viewport toolbars.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_VIEWPORT_PROFILER_DESC: Shows runtime timing information over the preview.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_PLATFORM_DESC: Target platform used by the build profile.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_PROFILING_DESC: Developer build diagnostics and profiling options.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_MORE_BUILD_OPTIONS_DESC: Open the dedicated Build tab for scenes, packaging, and export.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_MOVE_SPEED_DESC: Base speed for editor camera movement.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_SPRINT_SPEED_DESC: Fast movement speed while sprinting in the editor camera.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_SMOOTH_MOVEMENT_DESC: Softens editor camera starts and stops.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_ACCELERATION_DESC: How quickly smooth camera movement reaches full speed.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_MOUSE_SENSITIVITY_DESC: Look sensitivity for the editor camera.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_CAMERA_PROJECTION_DESC: Developer controls for the editor camera projection.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_HIERARCHY_TEXTURE_PREVIE: Shows small material texture thumbnails in the Hierarchy panel.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_PITCH_STRETCH_DESC: Adjusts how 2.5D art responds to camera pitch.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_PITCH_STRENGTH_DESC: Internal stretch, compression, and shear tuning.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_SNAP_PRESETS_DESC: Switch between clean precision and retro snapped presentation.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_SNAP_DETAILS_DESC: Internal snap toggles and step sizes for the 2.5D presentation layer.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_SCENE_GIZMOS_DESC: Shows editor-only visual handles and overlays.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_3_D_GRID_DESC: Shows the scene grid in 3D viewports.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_SHOW_DEVELOPER_TOOLS_DES: Reveals debug sections and extra developer menus.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_SELECTION_COLLIDER_BOUND: Draws collider wireframes for selected objects.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_EDITOR_VSYNC_DESC: Paces the editor window to the display refresh. Turning this off lets the editor free-run, which makes frame times swing as the driver throttles presentation.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_FPS_CAP_DESC: Limits frame rate when VSync is off. It is bypassed while presentation is already synchronized.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_2_D_LIGHT_DEBUG_DESC: Lighting stats overlay and internal render resolution (ships with the game).
SETTINGS_BUILD_PLATFORM_DESC: Target operating system for the build profile.
SETTINGS_BUILD_ARCHITECTURE_DESC: CPU architecture for the target platform.
SETTINGS_BUILD_SPECIAL_BUILDS_DESC: Internal build modes for script-only or server exports.
SETTINGS_BUILD_COMPRESSION_DESC: Compression method used by exported packages.
SETTINGS_COMPILATION_AUTO_COMPILE_ON_SAV: Compile scripts automatically when a script file is saved.
SETTINGS_COMPILATION_SCAN_INTERVAL_DESC: How often the editor checks for script changes.
SETTINGS_COMPILATION_C_STANDARD_DESC: Default is C++23. Use another standard only when a project needs a different target.
SETTINGS_COMPILATION_SCRIPTS_DIRECTORY_D: Folder containing project script source files.
SETTINGS_COMPILATION_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DE: Folder where compiled script binaries are written.
SETTINGS_ASSETS_LOADED_OBJ_MESHES_DESC: Imported .obj meshes available to this project.
SETTINGS_ASSETS_LOADED_MODELS_DESC: Imported Assimp-supported model assets available to this project.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_GLOBAL_SIMULATION_DESC: Project-wide gravity, timing, and solver defaults.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_RAYCASTS_DESC: Default raycast behavior for project tools and runtime helpers.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_RIGIDBODY_DEFAULTS_DESC: Default values used when new rigidbodies are added.
SETTINGS_PHYSICS_DEFAULT_PHYSICS_MATERIA: Surface behavior used by newly authored physics materials.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_RENDERER_BACKEND_DESC: Renderer API and OpenGL renderer controls.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_RUNTIME_GRAPHICS_DESC: Startup graphics behavior for the player.
SETTINGS_GRAPHICS_PREVIEW_OVERRIDES_DESC: Editor and game preview graphics overrides.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_RENDERING_PATH_2_DESC: Light budget mode, Modularity's take on Forward/Deferred.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_MAIN_LIGHT_2_DESC: The directional light(s) with guaranteed slots.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_ADDITIONAL_LIGHTS_2_DE: Point, spot, and area lights competing for the budget.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_MODEL_DESC: Choose which surface-lighting contributions the renderer evaluates.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_SPECULAR_DESC: Adds view-dependent highlights and reflection casts. Disable it to render ambient and diffuse lighting only.
SETTINGS_LIGHTING_2_D_LIGHTING_DESC: Lighting for the 2D world. Shown because this project has the 2D world package.
SETTINGS_TAGS_LAYERS_DESC: Name-based layers with stable internal numeric indices.
SETTINGS_CONSOLE_CONSOLE_BEHAVIOR_DESC: How the console appears while editing and testing.
SETTINGS_PLAYER_BUILD_DEFAULTS_DESC: Default target and save-data behavior for player builds.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_2_5_D_PRESENTATION_DESC: Technical presentation controls for TM/vexel projects.
SETTINGS_BUILD_BUILD_TARGETS_DESC: Platform and packaging options for exported builds.
SETTINGS_BUILD_SCENES_IN_BUILD_DESC: Scene list included in the exported build.
SETTINGS_BUILD_EXPORT_DESC: Save or open the dedicated build/export window.
SETTINGS_OPENXR_OPEN_XR_MANAGEMENT_DESC: VR and OpenXR project support status.
SETTINGS_PLAYER_WINDOW_AND_CURSOR_DESC: Startup resolution, fullscreen mode, and cursor defaults.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_PROJECT_DESC: Project identity and the broad mode this project uses.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_BUILD_DESC: Build profile shortcuts. Full controls remain in the Build tab.
SETTINGS_EDITOR_EDITOR_DESC: Camera movement and editor-only viewport aids.
SETTINGS_COMPILATION_SCRIPTS_MODU_DESC: Project script compiler configuration and compatibility settings.
MENU_WORKFLOW_SOUNDS_BOOT_NOTE: Boot intro sound is always enabled.
